subject: general
question: 'waiting for a visa' is whose autobiography?
solution:
The correct answer is __**BR Ambedkar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Waiting for a Visa** is an autobiography written by **BR Ambedkar**.
 
• BR Ambedkar was an Indian jurist, economist, politician, and social reformer who inspired the Dalit Buddhist movement and campaigned against social discrimination towards the untouchables (Dalits).
 
• He was the principal architect of the Constitution of India.</li
